nodes.name: runtime-config-gating.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the per-org runtime-config enablement gating of connector tools: disabled providers and breadth connectors with breadthEnabled=false are hidden from tool defs, names, and execution.

nodes.name: slack.descriptor.ts
nodes.summary: Declarative ConnectorDescriptor for the Slack connector, referencing the Slack tool schemas, executor, and egress exposure maps for registration in the connector registry.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: The declarative connector contract: ConnectorDescriptor, ConnectorAvailability (the gov-block axis), and ConnectorToolContext types that re-express connector wiring as data under a zero-behavior-change invariant.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses type-only imports from the egress types module to keep the connector type layer free of the egress runtime graph.

nodes.name: conversation-title.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for AI conversation title generation, covering title cleaning rules (quotes, prefixes, length caps) and fallback behavior when the model output is unusable.

nodes.name: conversation-title.ts
nodes.summary: Generates a short title for an assistant conversation by running a model turn through the egress chokepoint over the first user/assistant messages, then sanitizing the raw output with cleanTitle and falling back to DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_TITLE.

nodes.name: registerConnector
nodes.summary: Registers a ConnectorDescriptor, validating global tool-name uniqueness across descriptors and consistency between a descriptor's tool defs and its egress map keys before adding it.

nodes.name: getConnectorDescriptors
nodes.summary: Returns the currently registered connector descriptors as a read-only snapshot.

nodes.name: allConnectorProviders
nodes.summary: Lists the provider ids of every registered connector descriptor.

nodes.name: commercialOnlyProviders
nodes.summary: Lists the provider ids of connectors whose availability is commercial-only, i.e. the set that must be invisible to government tenants.

nodes.name: connectorToolDefs
nodes.summary: Flattens tool definitions from all descriptors visible to a tenant class, further narrowed by the org's runtime-config enablement filter.

nodes.name: connectorToolNames
nodes.summary: Returns the set of connector tool names available to a tenant class under the current runtime-config enablement, derived from the tool-name ownership map.

nodes.name: executeConnectorTool
nodes.summary: Dispatches a connector tool call to its owning descriptor's executor, hard-refusing (with an audit-logged egress decision and hashed input) when the tenant class is not allowed or the provider is disabled by runtime config.

nodes.name: connectorEgressMaps
nodes.summary: Merges every descriptor's TOOL_ENTITY, EXPOSABLE_FIELDS, and HANDLEABLE_FIELDS contributions into the combined egress maps, asserting consistency when two descriptors define the same key.

nodes.name: resetConnectors
nodes.summary: Clears the registry's descriptor list and tool-name ownership map; a test-only escape hatch for isolating registration state between test cases.

nodes.name: cleanTitle
nodes.summary: Sanitizes raw model output into a usable conversation title: takes the first non-empty line, strips 'Title:' prefixes, surrounding quotes, and trailing punctuation, and truncates to the maximum length.

nodes.name: generateConversationTitle
nodes.summary: Generates a conversation title by running a single model turn through the egress-controlled runModelTurn over truncated first user/assistant messages, then cleaning the result and falling back to the default title on failure.

nodes.name: gate.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the egress gate's projectForModel decision: exposure versus withholding by tenant class and classification ceiling, using a small context factory.

nodes.name: observe-only.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the observe-only (passthrough) behavior of runModelTurn: values flow to the model unmodified while egress decisions and classifier observations are still recorded for audit.

nodes.name: projection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the field-level projection layer: TOOL_ENTITY mapping, exposable-field allowlists per entity type, and the structural/result projection helpers that strip non-exposable data.

nodes.name: audit.ts
nodes.summary: Persists egress decisions (content hash, exposure verdict, withheld counts — never CUI itself) to the EgressDecisionRow table and emits observability metrics, swallowing storage failures with a warning.

nodes.name: augment.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests augmentWithHandles: withheld handleable fields on projected tool results are replaced with opaque handles, across single entities, arrays, and keyed collections.

nodes.name: gate.ts
nodes.summary: The core egress gate: projectForModel decides whether a value may cross to the model by comparing its classification against the org ceiling and scanning for CUI markings, returning an exposure decision with a sha256 content hash for the audit trail.

nodes.name: handles.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the opaque-handle lifecycle: token format recognition, minting sealed handles, per-conversation resolution scoping, and deep resolution of handles nested in tool-call arguments with ceiling maximization.

nodes.name: handles.ts
nodes.summary: Opaque-handle subsystem for CUI-by-reference: mints random tokens whose values are vault-sealed into the EgressHandle table, resolves them scoped to a conversation, and deep-walks tool inputs to substitute handles back with their plaintext while tracking the maximum classification ceiling touched.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles are crypto.randomBytes tokens with a recognizable prefix; plaintext never leaves the database unsealed except through conversation-scoped resolution.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The single egress chokepoint and public barrel for the egress layer: runModelTurn gates system/user/tool values through projectForModel, runs the CUI classifier, logs every decision, resolves the org/user model credential, and calls the model provider inside an OpenTelemetry span.

nodes.name: projection.ts
nodes.summary: Field-level exposure policy for tool results: per-entity EXPOSABLE_FIELDS and HANDLEABLE_FIELDS allowlists plus TOOL_ENTITY mapping (merged with connector-declared maps), with projection helpers that strip non-exposable fields and augmentation that swaps withheld handleable fields for opaque handles.

nodes.name: logEgressDecision
nodes.summary: Records an egress decision to metrics and persists it to the EgressDecisionRow table (content hash and counts only, never CUI), logging a warning instead of throwing if the write fails.

nodes.name: sha256Hex
nodes.summary: Computes the sha256 hex digest of a serialized value, used as tamper-evident content hashing for egress audit records.

nodes.name: projectForModel
nodes.summary: The gate verdict function: decides whether a value is exposed to the model or withheld by ranking its classification against the ceiling and detecting CUI markings, returning the decision plus content hash.

nodes.name: isHandle
nodes.summary: Checks whether a string matches the opaque-handle token format (known prefix plus valid token body).

nodes.name: mintHandle
nodes.summary: Mints a new opaque handle for a withheld value: seals the plaintext with the vault, generates a random token, and stores the sealed record with its classification ceiling scoped to the conversation.

nodes.name: resolveHandle
nodes.summary: Resolves an opaque handle token back to its plaintext value by looking up the sealed record scoped to the conversation and opening it with the vault; returns null for unknown or foreign-conversation tokens.

nodes.name: resolveHandlesDeep
nodes.summary: Recursively walks an arbitrary tool-input structure, replacing every embedded handle token with its resolved plaintext and accumulating the maximum classification ceiling of all touched handles.

nodes.name: toModelTools
nodes.summary: Maps internal tool definitions to the model-facing ModelTool shape expected by the provider layer.

nodes.name: runModelTurn
nodes.summary: The single model-call chokepoint: computes the effective classification ceiling, gates system and message values through projectForModel with per-value audit logging, runs the CUI classifier as an observer, resolves the org/user model credential, and invokes callModel within a traced span with error metrics.

nodes.name: entityTypeForTool
nodes.summary: Looks up the entity type a tool's results belong to via the merged TOOL_ENTITY map (static entries plus connector-declared entries).

nodes.name: projectOne
nodes.summary: Projects a single entity object down to its exposable-field allowlist, dropping every field not explicitly permitted for model visibility.

nodes.name: projectStructural
nodes.summary: Applies the exposable-field projection to a value or array of values for a given entity type, preserving structure.

nodes.name: projectResult
nodes.summary: Projects a full tool result for an entity type, handling plain objects, arrays, and container objects whose keys hold entity arrays, so only allowlisted fields reach the model.

nodes.name: augmentOneEntity
nodes.summary: For one projected entity, mints opaque handles for handleable fields that were withheld from the model view and attaches the handle tokens in place of the plaintext.

nodes.name: augmentWithHandles
nodes.summary: Walks a projected model view alongside its source output (entities, arrays, or keyed collections) and augments each entity with opaque handles for withheld handleable fields, scoped to the conversation and ceiling.

nodes.name: provider.ts
nodes.summary: Stateless model-calling provider behind the egress chokepoint: callModel routes to the Anthropic SDK (API key or Claude subscription OAuth) or to a raw OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint over fetch, with streaming support, message/tool shape conversion, and finish-reason normalization.
nodes.languageNotes: The OpenAI path parses server-sent-event stream chunks by hand and accumulates tool-call deltas in a Map instead of using an SDK.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Dependency-free type module for the egress layer: TenantClass, ModelCredential variants (apiKey/oauth/openai), ValueKind, EgressMode, EgressContext, and the CUI-free EgressDecision audit record, plus the isWithheld guard.

nodes.name: github.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the GitHub tool executor using an injectable mocked fetch: issue/PR listing and shaping, repo resolution, error paths, and credential fallback behavior.

nodes.name: github.ts
nodes.summary: GitHub tool executor for the AI assistant: resolves an org token and default repo from credentials or the Integration record, then serves github_list_issues, github_get_issue, and github_list_pull_requests against the GitHub REST API with clamped limits and shaped results.

nodes.name: jira.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the Jira tool executor with a mocked fetch: JQL search, issue retrieval and shaping, project listing, issue creation, and verification that shaped issues stay within the egress exposability contract.

nodes.name: jira.ts
nodes.summary: Jira Cloud tool executor: resolves site URL and basic-auth credentials, wraps the Jira REST API with jiraFetch, and serves JQL search, issue get/create, and project listing with JQL quoting and a stable shaped issue format, dispatched via executeJiraTool.

nodes.name: microsoft365.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the Microsoft 365 executor with mocked Graph responses: user/message/event/drive-item listing, limit clamping, error propagation, and exposability of shaped results.

nodes.name: microsoft365.ts
nodes.summary: Microsoft 365 tool executor built on the Graph client: lists users, mail messages, calendar events, and drive items with clamped limits and safe error wrapping, dispatched via executeMicrosoft365Tool.

nodes.name: nango.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the Nango breadth-connector executor: tool-name coverage and dispatch behavior of executeNangoTool including error handling for unknown tools.

nodes.name: clientFor
nodes.summary: Constructs an Anthropic SDK client for the given credential, using x-api-key for API keys or Bearer auth with the OAuth beta header for Claude subscription tokens.

nodes.name: buildSystem
nodes.summary: Builds the effective system prompt for the request, adjusting for credential kind before the model call.

nodes.name: blockContentToString
nodes.summary: Flattens Anthropic-style content blocks (text blocks, strings, or arbitrary objects) into a single string for OpenAI-format messages.

nodes.name: toOpenAiMessages
nodes.summary: Converts the internal system prompt and Anthropic-shaped message history (including tool_use and tool_result blocks) into the OpenAI Chat Completions message format with tool_calls and tool-role messages.

nodes.name: mapFinishReason
nodes.summary: Normalizes OpenAI finish reasons (stop, tool_calls, length, etc.) to the internal stop-reason vocabulary shared with the Anthropic path.

nodes.name: callOpenAi
nodes.summary: Executes a model turn against an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint via raw fetch, supporting both streamed and non-streamed responses, and maps the result into the internal turn shape.

nodes.name: parseOpenAiToolCalls
nodes.summary: Parses OpenAI tool_calls entries into internal ModelToolUse objects, JSON-parsing each call's argument string defensively.

nodes.name: readOpenAiStream
nodes.summary: Manually reads an OpenAI server-sent-event stream: decodes chunks, splits data lines, forwards text deltas to the caller, accumulates tool-call argument fragments per index, and returns the assembled message with a normalized finish reason.

nodes.name: callModel
nodes.summary: The provider entry point: routes openai-kind credentials to callOpenAi, otherwise builds an Anthropic client and runs a streaming or non-streaming messages call, collecting text and tool uses into the ModelTurnResult.

nodes.name: isWithheld
nodes.summary: Type guard identifying the sentinel object that marks a value withheld by the egress gate.

nodes.name: resolveGitHubAccess
nodes.summary: Resolves the GitHub token and default repository for an org, preferring the stored org credential and falling back to the Integration record in the database.

nodes.name: resolveRepo
nodes.summary: Determines the owner/repo pair for a tool call from explicit arguments or configured defaults, validating the format.

nodes.name: githubGet
nodes.summary: Performs an authenticated GET against the GitHub REST API (with injectable fetch for tests) and returns parsed JSON, surfacing HTTP errors distinctly.

nodes.name: labelNames
nodes.summary: Extracts label name strings from GitHub's mixed string/object label arrays, filtering out malformed entries.

nodes.name: githubListIssues
nodes.summary: Lists repository issues (excluding pull requests) with state and limit normalization, returning issues shaped to a stable minimal field set.

nodes.name: githubGetIssue
nodes.summary: Fetches a single issue by number and shapes it, including labels and body, for model consumption.

nodes.name: githubListPullRequests
nodes.summary: Lists repository pull requests with state and limit normalization, shaping each PR to a stable minimal field set.

nodes.name: executeGitHubTool
nodes.summary: Dispatch entry for GitHub tools: routes a tool name to the matching list/get implementation and errors on unknown names.

nodes.name: resolveJiraAccess
nodes.summary: Resolves the Jira site URL, account email, and API token for an org from stored credentials/integration config, validating that all pieces are present.

nodes.name: jiraFetch
nodes.summary: Wraps the Jira Cloud REST API with basic-auth headers, JSON bodies, injectable fetch, and distinct handling of HTTP error statuses.

nodes.name: shapeIssue
nodes.summary: Shapes a raw Jira issue payload into the stable minimal issue format (key, summary, status, assignee, dates) served to the model.

nodes.name: jiraSearchIssues
nodes.summary: Searches Jira issues with a JQL query (safely quoting user-provided values) and returns shaped issues with a clamped limit.

nodes.name: jiraGetIssue
nodes.summary: Fetches a single Jira issue by key and returns it in the shaped issue format.

nodes.name: jiraListProjects
nodes.summary: Lists Jira projects visible to the credential, shaping key, name, and type fields.

nodes.name: jiraCreateIssue
nodes.summary: Creates a Jira issue from tool arguments (project, type, summary, description, assignee), building the ADF description body and returning the created issue reference.

nodes.name: executeJiraTool
nodes.summary: Dispatch entry for Jira tools: routes a tool name to search/get/list/create implementations and errors on unknown names.

nodes.name: m365ListUsers
nodes.summary: Lists directory users via Microsoft Graph with a clamped limit, shaping display name, mail, and job title fields.

nodes.name: m365ListMessages
nodes.summary: Lists mailbox messages via Microsoft Graph with optional search/filter, shaping subject, sender, and received time.

nodes.name: m365ListEvents
nodes.summary: Lists calendar events via Microsoft Graph in a time window, shaping subject, organizer, and start/end times.

nodes.name: m365ListDriveItems
nodes.summary: Lists OneDrive/SharePoint drive items via Microsoft Graph, shaping name, size, and modified metadata.

nodes.name: executeMicrosoft365Tool
nodes.summary: Dispatch entry for Microsoft 365 tools: routes a tool name to the matching Graph-backed list implementation.

nodes.name: nango.ts
nodes.summary: Executor for the Nango connector tools — the commercial-only unified-API path that routes agent tool calls (list/get connections, proxy requests) through the in-boundary Nango broker, org-scoped. Hard-refuses gov tenants at the top of every entry as the last defense-in-depth layer (D5 gov-block layer 3).
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a triple-layered governance block: even though gov tenants never see these tools upstream, the executor independently re-checks tenantClass before any broker call.

nodes.name: slack.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest suite for the Slack tool executors, mocking fetch and the credential layer to verify channel listing, message search, safe posting, and egress projection of Slack API responses.

nodes.name: slack.ts
nodes.summary: Slack tool executors for the AI assistant — read-focused (list channels, search messages) plus one safe write (post message). Resolves the org-shared sealed bot token via getOrgCredential and calls the Slack Web API with graceful error returns so the model can recover from a missing connection.
nodes.languageNotes: Slack returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false,error} on failures, so the executor inspects the body rather than the status code; all tools funnel through a safeRun wrapper that converts throws into {error} results.

nodes.name: model-credential-provider.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the model-credential provider registry, covering the fail-safe null result when no provider is registered and delegation once a provider is installed.

nodes.name: model-credential-provider.ts
nodes.summary: Dependency-inversion seam (ADR 0003) that lets core's feedback-intake LLM judges obtain a model credential without importing the Foreman plugin: Foreman registers a provider at composition time, and resolveModelCredential fails safe to null when nothing is registered.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level singleton registry used to break a core-to-plugin coupling so the Foreman plugin can be extracted to its own repo.

nodes.name: domains.test.ts
nodes.summary: Arch/contract test asserting that every registered tool name — native cosmosTools plus every connector tool — has an explicit entry in the TOOL_DOMAIN map, so new tools surface as a deliberate policy edit.

nodes.name: domains.ts
nodes.summary: Flat, exhaustive tool-to-coarse-data-domain map powering the AgentPolicy DOMAIN axis: deniedDomains on an org policy blocks every tool whose domain is listed. Exports KNOWN_DOMAINS, the TOOL_DOMAIN record, and the domainForTool lookup with a DEFAULT_DOMAIN fallback for unknown tools.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately kept as one flat explicit record (not derived) so reviewers can audit each domain's blast radius at a glance; a contract test enforces exhaustiveness.

nodes.name: enforce.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for checkAgentPolicy covering all three policy axes — tool allow/deny lists, domain denial, and argument bounds — including precedence rules like denylist beating allowlist and clamping behavior.

nodes.name: enforce.ts
nodes.summary: Pure 3-axis AgentPolicy decision function (checkAgentPolicy) called by the agent loop before every tool execution: evaluates deniedTools/allowedTools, then tool domain denial, then argument constraints (projectId allowlist, numeric bounds), with first-deny-wins semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Intentionally pure — never touches the DB, model, or CUI — so the whole policy gate is exhaustively unit-testable.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Per-org AgentPolicy loader that reads the AgentPolicy row from Prisma and normalizes it into the shape consumed by checkAgentPolicy, with a load-bearing permissive default when no row exists so pre-policy orgs behave unchanged.

nodes.name: tools.ts
nodes.summary: Central AI tool registry: defines the ToolDefinition type, aggregates all native tool catalogs (work items, OKRs, finance, CRM, boards, PM registers, etc.) plus connector tool defs into the cosmosTools array, re-exports every catalog, and formats tool schemas for the system prompt.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as the single composition point for the agent's tool surface — 20 catalog imports merged into one exported array consumed by the agent loop and chat bots.

nodes.name: accounting.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring the accounting query tools (e.g. trial balance and ledger reads) exposed to the AI assistant as Anthropic tool schemas.

nodes.name: boards.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring board-related tools for the AI assistant, letting it query kanban board state.

nodes.name: comments.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring comment tools for the AI assistant, enabling reading and posting comments on work items and other subjects.

nodes.name: compliance.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring compliance-control query tools scoped to security frameworks (NIST 800-171, CMMC L2, FedRAMP, etc.) and implementation statuses.

nodes.name: crm.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog adding CRM write tools (create/update contacts) and partner/product list reads, mirroring the org CRM HTTP routes so assistant writes follow the same paths as human ones.

nodes.name: documents.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring document tools for the AI assistant, letting it list and read org documents.

nodes.name: feedback.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring feedback-portal tools for the AI assistant, covering feedback item queries and status interactions.

nodes.name: finance.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring finance tools (e.g. query_finance, revenue logging) exposed to the AI assistant.

nodes.name: github.ts
nodes.summary: GitHub tool catalog for the AI assistant — read-only issue and pull-request tools requiring an org-level sealed fine-grained PAT; executors live in the matching executors/github.ts and are wired via the connector registry.

nodes.name: goals-kpis.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring goal and KPI tools for the AI assistant, covering goal/KPI queries and progress updates.

nodes.name: jira.ts
nodes.summary: Jira Cloud tool catalog for the AI assistant — read-focused issue/search tools plus one safe write, backed by an org-shared sealed Atlassian API token credential.

nodes.name: meetings.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring meeting tools for the AI assistant, covering meeting queries and note/action-item access.

nodes.name: microsoft365.ts
nodes.summary: Microsoft 365 (Graph API) tool catalog for the AI assistant — read-only tools backed by an org-shared Entra app registration sealed into the org vault credential, using OAuth2 client-credentials auth.

nodes.name: milestones.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring milestone tools for the AI assistant, covering milestone queries and updates.

nodes.name: nango.ts
nodes.summary: Nango tool catalog — the commercial-only unified-API breadth path letting the assistant act against ~180 SaaS providers through the self-hosted Nango broker; credentials stay inside Nango and are org-scoped, with executors in executors/nango.ts.

nodes.name: notes.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring note tools for the AI assistant, covering note creation and retrieval.

nodes.name: okrs.ts
nodes.summary: Tool catalog declaring OKR tools for the AI assistant, covering objective/key-result queries, creation, and progress updates.

nodes.name: pm-register.ts
nodes.summary: PM Dashboard register tool catalog letting the assistant read and update the govcon PM registers — risks, blockers, deliverables, change requests — and comment on drill-in subjects; writes mirror the project risk HTTP routes so auto-coding and activity logging stay identical for humans and the assistant.

nodes.name: executeNangoTool
nodes.summary: Dispatches the three Nango tools (list connections, get connection, proxy request) against the org-scoped Nango client after hard-refusing gov tenants and unknown tool names.

nodes.name: resolveSlackAccess
nodes.summary: Resolves the org's sealed Slack bot token via getOrgCredential and the optional defaultChannel from the plaintext Integration config row.

nodes.name: slackCall
nodes.summary: Low-level Slack Web API caller that sends authenticated GET/POST requests and normalizes Slack's 200-with-ok:false error convention into thrown errors.

nodes.name: slackListChannels
nodes.summary: Lists the workspace's public/private channels via conversations.list with a clamped limit, projecting each channel to a minimal safe shape.

nodes.name: slackSearchMessages
nodes.summary: Searches Slack messages via search.messages with query trimming, clamped result count, and projection of matches to a compact result shape.

nodes.name: slackPostMessage
nodes.summary: The single safe Slack write: posts a message via chat.postMessage to an explicit channel or the integration's configured default channel, validating non-empty text.

nodes.name: executeSlackTool
nodes.summary: Dispatch entry point mapping the three Slack tool names to their executor functions, returning an error result for unknown names.

nodes.name: registerModelCredentialProvider
nodes.summary: Registers the singleton model-credential resolver, called by the Foreman plugin's server hooks at composition time.

nodes.name: resolveModelCredential
nodes.summary: Resolves a per-org model credential through the registered provider, returning null (never throwing) when no provider is registered or the resolver fails, so intake judges degrade gracefully.

nodes.name: domainForTool
nodes.summary: Looks up a tool's coarse data-domain in TOOL_DOMAIN, falling back to DEFAULT_DOMAIN for unknown tool names.

nodes.name: checkAgentPolicy
nodes.summary: Pure decision function for the AgentPolicy gate: evaluates the tool allow/deny axis, the domain-denial axis, and the args axis (projectId allowlist and numeric clamps) in order, with first deny winning.

nodes.name: getAgentPolicy
nodes.summary: Loads the org's AgentPolicy row via Prisma and normalizes it, returning the permissive default when no row exists.

nodes.name: normalizeAgentPolicy
nodes.summary: Converts a raw AgentPolicy DB row (or null) into the clean AgentPolicy shape consumed by checkAgentPolicy, applying the permissive defaults for missing fields.

nodes.name: formatToolsForSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Renders an array of tool definitions into a plain-text block (name, description, JSON schema) for embedding in the agent's system prompt.

nodes.name: rag.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ragTools catalog containing the semantic_search tool definition, letting the AI assistant search notes, work items, contracts, and meetings by similarity score.

nodes.name: slack.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the slackTools catalog for the AI assistant: read-focused Slack tools (list channels, search messages) plus one safe write (post message), using the org-level Slack bot token and routing results through the egress chokepoint so gov tenants only see structural fields.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive doc comments encode the security model: org-shared bot token from the vault, executors dispatched via the connector registry, and structural-only projection for gov tenants.

nodes.name: time.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the timeTools catalog of AI assistant tool definitions for time-tracking operations, each entry pairing a tool name and description with a JSON input schema.

nodes.name: utility.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the utilityTools catalog containing the fetch_url tool, which fetches a public http(s) URL as stripped text while refusing localhost/private IPs and not following redirects.

nodes.name: work-items.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the workItemTools catalog of AI assistant tool definitions for work-item (ticket) operations on boards, each with a JSON input schema consumed by the chat agent's tool registry.

nodes.name: tool-filter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for filterToolsByScope, verifying that chat-bot tool scopes (none / read-only / full) admit or reject the right subsets of the cosmosTools catalog.

nodes.name: tool-filter.ts
nodes.summary: Filters the AI tool catalog by a chat-bot tool scope: classifies tools as read-only via an explicit allowlist plus name-prefix heuristics, and exposes filterToolsByScope to restrict what a scoped bot may call.

nodes.name: classifier.test.ts
nodes.summary: Small unit test for classifyLikelyCui, checking that CUI-like text is flagged and benign text is not.

nodes.name: markings.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for detectMarkings, asserting that classification banner strings (e.g. CUI, SECRET markings) are detected in plain values and nested objects while unmarked content passes.

nodes.name: classifier.ts
nodes.summary: Heuristic CUI classifier: embeds input text and compares it against cached embeddings of CUI seed phrases with cosine similarity to decide whether content is likely Controlled Unclassified Information.
nodes.languageNotes: Seed embeddings are computed lazily once and memoized in a module-level promise, so repeated classifications reuse them.

nodes.name: effective.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the effective data-classification ceiling for an org/project by ranking classification levels, querying DataClassification rows via Prisma, and taking the maximum applicable level.

nodes.name: markings.ts
nodes.summary: Detects explicit classification markings (CUI/secret banner patterns) in arbitrary values by JSON-stringifying them and testing against a marking regex.

nodes.name: dedup-gate.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for dedupGate, covering family exclusion, prefilter thresholds, and that the judge callback only runs on the shortlisted candidates.

nodes.name: dedup-gate.ts
nodes.summary: Two-stage duplicate gate: excludes same-family candidates and applies the cheap token-overlap prefilter, then hands the surviving shortlist to an async judge (typically an LLM) for the final duplicate verdict.

nodes.name: filterToolsByScope
nodes.summary: Returns the subset of tool definitions a chat bot may use for a given scope: empty for none, read-only tools (allowlist plus prefix heuristics) for read scope, or the full catalog otherwise.

nodes.name: classifyLikelyCui
nodes.summary: Embeds the given text and the CUI seed phrases, then returns whether the best cosine similarity crosses the CUI-likeness threshold along with the score.

nodes.name: rankOf
nodes.summary: Maps a classification level string to its numeric rank in the severity order.

nodes.name: maxByRank
nodes.summary: Returns whichever of two classification levels has the higher rank, treating missing values as the base level.

nodes.name: effectiveCeiling
nodes.summary: Loads DataClassification rows for an org (and optional project) via Prisma and computes the highest-ranked applicable classification level as the effective ceiling.

nodes.name: detectMarkings
nodes.summary: JSON-stringifies an arbitrary value and tests it against the classification-marking regex, returning whether explicit CUI/secret banner markings are present.

nodes.name: dedupGate
nodes.summary: Runs the duplicate-detection funnel: filters out same-family candidates, prefilters by token overlap against a threshold, and delegates the shortlist to the injected async judge for the final verdict.

nodes.name: dedup.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the dedup primitives, checking title normalization and token-overlap scoring behavior.

nodes.name: dedup.ts
nodes.summary: Dependency-free duplicate-detection primitives: title normalization, stop-word-aware tokenization, Jaccard-style token overlap scoring, family exclusion for parent/child refs, and a threshold prefilter that shortlists candidates best-first.

nodes.name: guardrails.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the feedback guardrail scanner, exercising prompt-injection and secret detector categories, risk scoring, hold decisions, and secret redaction on crafted feedback payloads.

nodes.name: guardrails.ts

nodes.name: intake-decision.test.ts

nodes.name: intake-guardrails.test.ts

nodes.name: intake-guardrails.ts

nodes.languageNotes: Model calls go through injected deps (runTurn/getCreds) rather than direct imports, keeping the judges unit-testable, and all feedback text is fenced via delimitUntrustedFeedback before reaching the model.

nodes.name: intake-policy.test.ts

nodes.name: intake-policy.ts

nodes.name: rate-limits.test.ts

nodes.name: rate-limits.ts

nodes.name: remediate.test.ts

nodes.name: role-gating.test.ts

nodes.name: normalizeTitle
nodes.summary: Lowercases a title, strips bracketed tags and non-alphanumeric characters, and collapses whitespace to produce a canonical comparison form.

nodes.name: tokenOverlap
nodes.summary: Scores similarity of two titles as the shared-token count divided by the smaller token set size, after normalization and stop-word removal.

nodes.name: excludeFamily
nodes.summary: Removes candidates that share a parent ref with the item being checked, so parent/sibling work items are never treated as duplicates of each other.

nodes.name: prefilter
nodes.summary: Scores every candidate by token overlap with the title, keeps those at or above the threshold, and returns them sorted best-first as the dedup shortlist.

nodes.name: redactSecrets
nodes.summary: Replaces every match of the secret patterns (API keys, tokens, credentials) in a text with redaction placeholders before the text is stored or shown to a model.

nodes.name: scanSecrets
nodes.summary: Tests a text against each secret pattern and returns labeled findings for every credential-like match detected.

nodes.name: scanFeedback
nodes.summary: Runs the full detector catalog (optionally filtered to configured high-risk zones) over feedback title and description, aggregates weighted findings into a risk score and categories, and decides whether the item should be held for review.

nodes.name: delimitUntrustedFeedback
nodes.summary: Redacts secrets from feedback text, neutralizes fence markers, and wraps it in explicit UNTRUSTED delimiters with a preamble instructing the model to treat the content as data, never as instructions.

nodes.name: describeIntakeDecision
nodes.summary: Inspects a feedback item's automation metadata record and returns a typed decision (flagged, duplicate, throttled, delivered, or pending) with a human-readable reason, guardrail score, and categories.

nodes.name: longestKeyboardRun
nodes.summary: Measures the longest run of adjacent keyboard-row characters in a text (e.g. 'asdfgh'), used as a gibberish signal for low-quality feedback detection.

nodes.name: detectLowQuality
nodes.summary: Applies cheap heuristics (minimum length, alphanumeric content, repeated single characters, keyboard runs, test-phrase patterns) to flag feedback as low quality before spending model budget on it.

nodes.name: buildDedupJudge
nodes.summary: Builds the async LLM judge for the dedup gate: resolves model credentials, presents the fenced feedback and shortlist to the model with a forced tool call, and validates that any returned duplicate ref actually exists in the shortlist.

nodes.name: findFeedbackDuplicate
nodes.summary: Runs the dedup gate over candidate work items and feedback using the LLM dedup judge, returning the matched duplicate ref and reason when one is found.

nodes.name: judgeFeedbackScope
nodes.summary: Asks the model (via injected deps) to classify fenced feedback as in-scope, out-of-scope, or unclear through a forced tool call, validating the returned class and normalizing the reason.

nodes.name: lowQualityResult
nodes.summary: Wraps a low-quality finding into the standard guardrail-style intake result used to park the feedback item.

nodes.name: duplicateResult
nodes.summary: Converts a duplicate match (ref plus judge reason) into the standard intake result record marking the item as a duplicate.

nodes.name: scopeResult
nodes.summary: Maps a scope-judge verdict to an intake result: out-of-scope items are parked with the judge's reason while in-scope or unclear verdicts allow the item to proceed.

nodes.name: readClassifier
nodes.summary: Parses the security-classifier section of org settings, validating the enabled flag and minimum-confidence value against the allowed set.

nodes.name: readIntakePolicy
nodes.summary: Composes the full intake policy from org settings by delegating to the limits, role-gate, classifier, and high-risk-zone readers.

nodes.name: serializeIntakePolicy
nodes.summary: Serializes an intake policy back into the settings JSON shape persisted on the organization record.

nodes.name: normalizeIntakePolicyInput
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes untrusted API input into a well-formed intake policy, filtering roles against the known org-role set and re-reading limits, classifier, and zone values through the strict readers.

nodes.name: readIntakeLimits
nodes.summary: Reads and clamps the four intake caps (per run, per user, backlog, build-cost budget) from org settings, falling back to defaults for missing or invalid values.

nodes.name: estimateBuildCost
nodes.summary: Estimates the delivery cost of a feedback item from its content length, used to enforce the per-run build budget.

nodes.name: duplicateSignature
nodes.summary: Derives a normalized lowercase signature from a feedback item's title and description so identical resubmissions within a run can be throttled cheaply.

nodes.name: planIntake
nodes.summary: Partitions candidate feedback into admitted and throttled sets by applying, in order, duplicate-signature suppression, backlog cap, per-user cap, per-run cap, and the build-cost budget, recording a throttle reason for each rejection.

nodes.name: throttleMessage
nodes.summary: Maps a throttle reason code to the user-facing message shown on throttled feedback items.

nodes.name: role-gating.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the canonical org role list and role-gating configuration for the feedback portal, determining which organization roles are allowed to auto-trigger feedback remediation.

nodes.name: readRoleGateConfig
nodes.summary: Parses untyped org settings JSON into a validated role-gate config, falling back to the default auto-trigger roles when values are missing or invalid.

nodes.name: canRoleAutoTrigger
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given org role is permitted to auto-trigger feedback remediation under the supplied role-gate config.

nodes.name: roleGateMessage
nodes.summary: Returns the user-facing explanation shown when a submitter's role is gated from auto-triggering remediation.

nodes.name: judgeFeedbackSecurity

nodes.name: invoicingAccounts

nodes.name: postPaymentToLedger

nodes.name: reverseInvoiceLedger

nodes.name: totals.test.ts

nodes.name: lineAmount

nodes.name: lineTax
nodes.summary: Computes the rounded tax for a line amount given a percentage tax rate.

nodes.name: invoiceTotals
nodes.summary: Aggregates invoice lines into subtotal, tax total and grand total using Decimal summation.

nodes.name: statusFor
nodes.summary: Derives the invoice status (e.g. paid or partially paid) by comparing the amount paid against the total, preserving the current status otherwise.

nodes.name: auto-post.ts

nodes.name: postRevenueToLedger

nodes.name: postExpenseToLedger
nodes.summary: Posts a journal entry for an expense record by resolving standard accounts and mapping the expense to posting lines.

nodes.name: safeAutoPost
nodes.summary: Runs an auto-posting function and swallows errors with a console log so ledger failures never break the primary finance write path.

nodes.name: chart-of-accounts.test.ts

nodes.name: resolveAccount

nodes.name: mappers.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests checking that revenue and expense records map to balanced double-entry posting lines.

nodes.name: mappers.ts
nodes.summary: Maps revenue and expense records to double-entry posting lines and provides backfillLedger, which seeds accounts and posts journal entries for all historical unposted revenues and expenses of an org.

nodes.name: revenueToPostingLines
nodes.summary: Maps a revenue record to posting lines debiting cash and crediting revenue.

nodes.name: expenseToPostingLines
nodes.summary: Maps an expense record to posting lines debiting the expense account and crediting cash.

nodes.name: backfillLedger
nodes.summary: Seeds the chart of accounts and posts journal entries for every historical revenue and expense not yet in the ledger, collecting per-record errors and returning posted/failed counts.

nodes.name: posting.test.ts

nodes.name: posting.ts
nodes.summary: Core double-entry journal engine: asserts entries balance with positive amounts, enforces closed accounting periods via ClosedPeriodError, posts entries with sequential numbering in a transaction, and supports voiding and reversing entries.

nodes.name: reversedLines

nodes.name: ClosedPeriodError

nodes.name: postEntry

nodes.name: isVoidable

nodes.name: voidEntry
nodes.summary: Marks a voidable journal entry as void after locating it within the org.

nodes.name: reverseEntry
nodes.summary: Creates a reversing journal entry with mirrored lines for an existing entry, respecting closed periods and sequential entry numbering in a transaction.

nodes.name: index.test.ts

nodes.name: index.ts

nodes.name: sumMoney

nodes.name: multiplyMoney

nodes.name: roundMoney

nodes.name: moneyToNumber
nodes.summary: Converts a Decimal money value to a plain JavaScript number for display or JSON output.

nodes.name: health.test.ts

nodes.name: labor.test.ts

nodes.name: embedText

nodes.name: cosineSimilarity

nodes.name: toVectorLiteral
nodes.summary: Serializes a number array into a pgvector literal string.

nodes.name: storeEmbedding
nodes.summary: Embeds text for a given table row and writes the vector to its pgvector embedding column with a raw SQL update.

nodes.name: dependency-graph.test.ts

nodes.name: subjects.ts

Used by PM activity, comment, and link API routes to validate polymorphic subject references.

nodes.name: isPmSubjectType
nodes.summary: Type guard that checks whether a string is one of the known PM subject types.

nodes.name: resolvePmSubject

nodes.name: resolveLinkSubject

nodes.name: vendor.ts

nodes.name: builtin-work-roles-seed.test.ts

Performs no authorization itself — callers must enforce the platform-admin guards.

nodes.summary: Displays a labeled count tile in the work-item import report.

nodes.name: convert.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest suite for the document-block conversion pipeline: mocks the storage layer and RAG embedding, ingests fixture documents with ingestDocument, then asserts the block-to-work-item/milestone/table conversions write the expected Prisma records.

nodes.name: ingest.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test for ingestDocument that mocks the storage backend so no MinIO instance is required, feeding fixture files and asserting the ingested document rows.

nodes.name: convert.ts
nodes.summary: Server-side conversion library turning ingested document blocks into first-class records: single blocks become work items, milestones, objectives, goals, intervals, roadmap nodes, or generic items, and tables become batches of work items. Resolves target types/columns, scopes everything to org and project, and stores RAG embeddings for created items.

nodes.name: resolveTypeAndColumn
nodes.summary: Resolves the work-item type and default board column a converted block should land in for a given project.

nodes.name: convertBlockToWorkItem
nodes.summary: Creates a work item from a single document block's text, linking it back to the source block and placing it on the resolved board column.

nodes.name: convertBlockToMilestone
nodes.summary: Creates a milestone record from a document block, deriving title and body from the block text.

nodes.name: convertTableToWorkItems
nodes.summary: Converts a table block into one work item per data row, mapping table columns onto work-item fields.

nodes.name: convertBlockToObjective
nodes.summary: Creates an OKR objective from a document block within the org/project scope.

nodes.name: convertBlockToGoal
nodes.summary: Creates a delivery goal record from a document block's text.

nodes.name: convertBlockToInterval
nodes.summary: Creates a planning interval (e.g. sprint/PI) from a document block, parsing any date hints from the text.

nodes.name: convertBlockToRoadmapNode
nodes.summary: Creates a roadmap node from a document block, using roadmapSlug to key it into the project's roadmap.

nodes.name: convertBlockToItem
nodes.summary: Creates a generic item from a document block and stores a RAG embedding for the new record.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route exposing the current user's Google Calendar: GET lists upcoming events and POST creates an event via the per-user Google OAuth client, with rate limiting and a 428 hint when Google is not connected.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lists the user's upcoming Google Calendar events within an optional time window, returning a not-connected error when no Google token exists.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a Google Calendar event from the request body using the user's OAuth-backed calendar client.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route listing the current user's Google Drive files through the per-user OAuth Drive client, with rate limiting, optional search query, and a not-connected fallback error.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lists Google Drive files for the authenticated user with optional query and page-size limits.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route listing the current user's recent Gmail messages: fetches message ids then hydrates headers/snippets in parallel via the per-user Gmail client.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lists recent Gmail messages, fetching metadata for each id in parallel and filtering failed lookups.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Slash-command dispatcher for a chat channel: handles /topic, /invite, /kick, /leave, /mute, /ai and /notes, enforcing channel management rules, posting system messages, and detaching AI bot runs.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Parses and executes a slash command against the channel: mutates topic/membership, posts server messages, publishes realtime events, and fires runChatBot for /ai and /notes without awaiting.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route letting an org member join a public chat channel; rejects private/DM channels and publishes a channels-updated event to the joining user.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Upserts the caller as a member of a public channel and notifies them via the realtime bus.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route letting a member leave a chat channel; blocks leaving the general channel and DMs, then removes membership and publishes a realtime update.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Deletes the caller's channel membership (guarding general/DM channels) and publishes a channels-updated event.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route for removing a specific member from a chat channel; requires channel-manage rights, refuses to remove the last member, and notifies the removed user in realtime.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: Removes a user from a channel after manage-permission and last-member checks, then publishes a realtime update to the removed user.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route for chat channel membership: GET returns the sorted member roster with display names, POST bulk-adds org members to the channel for users with manage rights.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lists channel members joined with user display names and avatars, sorted alphabetically.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Validates that all requested userIds are org members, bulk-inserts channel memberships, and notifies each added user over the realtime bus.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Core chat message route: GET pages message history (with reactions, attachments, and reply counts) and POST creates a message, then detaches an AI bot run when the message mentions a bot and the sender has AI permission.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the latest messages for a channel in chronological order with cursor-based pagination, gated by channel visibility.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a user message via createUserMessage (idempotent on clientMsgId), then resolves any bot mention and fires runChatBot without awaiting.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route to unpin a message from a chat channel, publishing a pin-removed realtime event to channel subscribers.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: Deletes the pinned-message record for a channel (idempotent) and broadcasts chat.pin.removed.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route for channel pins: GET lists pinned messages with pinner/author info, POST pins a message (max 50 per channel), broadcasts the pin event, and posts a system message.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lists a channel's pinned messages including message content and the user who pinned each.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Pins a message after visibility, existence, and per-channel cap checks, publishes chat.pin.added, and posts a server message announcing the pin.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route recording a user's read position in a channel: updates lastReadMessageId/lastReadAt and publishes read-state events to both the reader and the channel.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Persists the caller's last-read message for the channel and emits chat.read realtime events.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route broadcasting a typing indicator for a channel over the realtime bus; heavily rate-limited and gated on post permission, with no persistence.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Publishes a chat.typing event with the caller's identity and an expiry timestamp after access and rate-limit checks.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Chat channel collection route: GET returns the caller's channels/DMs with unread counts and DM participant info; POST creates a channel (slug validation, optional privacy, project linking, initial members) in a transaction with audit logging.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Builds the caller's channel list from their memberships, enriching DMs and group DMs with the other participants' names and avatars.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a chat channel and its initial memberships in one transaction, validating the slug, member ids, and optional project link, then audits and notifies members.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route that opens (or returns the existing) direct-message channel for a set of users, using a deterministic sorted-participants DM key to deduplicate conversations.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Finds an existing DM/group-DM by its canonical participant key or creates one transactionally, then notifies all participants.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route removing the caller's emoji reaction from a chat message and broadcasting a reaction-removed event to the message's channel.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: Deletes the caller's reaction for the decoded emoji (idempotent) and publishes chat.reaction.removed.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route adding an emoji reaction to a chat message: validates channel visibility, upserts the reaction, and broadcasts a reaction-added event, with rate limiting.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Upserts the caller's emoji reaction on a message after access checks and publishes chat.reaction.added.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Single chat message route: PATCH lets the author edit their message within an edit window, DELETE soft-deletes a message by the author or a channel manager, both broadcasting realtime updates.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: Edits a message's content (author-only) and publishes chat.message.updated with the edited flag.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: Soft-deletes a message when allowed by canDeleteMessageGiven (author or manager) and publishes chat.message.deleted.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Server-Sent Events endpoint streaming realtime org events: subscribes the caller to org, user, and member-channel topics on the bus, tracks presence with heartbeats, and cleans up on disconnect.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a ReadableStream start/cancel pair to bridge the in-process/pg event bus into an SSE response, with a heartbeat interval doubling as a presence keep-alive.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Opens an SSE stream scoped to the caller's org/user/channel topics, registers presence connect/heartbeat/disconnect, and forwards bus events as SSE frames.

nodes.name: access.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the pure chat access predicates, covering public/private/DM visibility, cross-org denial, posting, channel management, and message deletion rules.

nodes.name: access.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, testable access-control predicates for chat channels (see/post/manage/delete-message) plus loadChannelAndMembership, the single DB helper routes use to fetch a channel and the viewer's membership.

nodes.name: canSeeChannelGiven
nodes.summary: Decides channel visibility: org-scoped public channels are visible to all org members, private channels and DMs only to their members.

nodes.name: canPostToChannelGiven
nodes.summary: Decides posting rights: DMs require membership, public channels allow any org member, private channels require membership.

nodes.name: canManageChannelGiven
nodes.summary: Decides channel management rights: org OWNER/ADMIN or a channel OWNER/ADMIN member, never for DMs.

nodes.name: canDeleteMessageGiven
nodes.summary: Decides message deletion rights: the author may always delete; otherwise channel-manage rights are required.

nodes.name: loadChannelAndMembership
nodes.summary: Fetches a channel and the viewer's membership row in parallel, the shared precondition lookup for chat routes.

nodes.name: ai-context.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for formatAiContext, verifying chronological transcript formatting, <@uuid> mention resolution to display names, and the '@someone' fallback that never leaks raw ids.

nodes.name: ai-context.ts
nodes.summary: Formats recent chat messages into a plain-text transcript for AI bot prompts, resolving <@uuid> mentions to human display names with a safe '@someone' fallback.

nodes.name: formatAiContext
nodes.summary: Renders messages oldest-first as 'Name: text' lines with mention resolution and an optional preamble for the model context.

nodes.name: bot-runner.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for detectBotMention, covering start/mid-sentence mentions, case-insensitivity, trailing punctuation, and the email/domain false-positive guard.

nodes.name: bot-runner.ts
nodes.summary: In-channel AI bot engine: runs assistant/notetaker/answerer bots through the shared CUI-blind agent loop with a three-layer security model (bot authorship, invoker-scoped capabilities with toolScope ceilings, egress-gated tool results), including throttled streaming of assistant replies over the realtime bus.
nodes.languageNotes: Bots are synthetic User rows, tools always execute as the invoking human, and streamed deltas are coalesced to ~5 bus publishes/sec; the answerer's NO_GROUNDED_ANSWER sentinel makes it stay silent rather than guess.

nodes.name: systemPromptFor
nodes.summary: Builds the per-bot system prompt from persona, channel name/topic, project linkage, and formatted conversation context.

nodes.name: runChatBot
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a full bot run: loads channel/org/bot config, builds AI context, filters tools by scope (notetaker allow-list, toolScope ceiling), runs the agent loop, and posts or streams the reply, honoring the answerer's silent sentinel.

nodes.name: runStreamingAssistant
nodes.summary: Streams an assistant reply: lazily creates a placeholder ASSISTANT message on first delta, publishes throttled streaming events, and finalizes or cleans up on error.

nodes.name: finalizeAssistantMessage
nodes.summary: Persists the final streamed content, publishes chat.message.updated, and fans out notifications for the completed bot reply.

nodes.name: detectBotMention
nodes.summary: Regex-detects a deliberate @notetaker/@answerer/@assistant/@ai mention while rejecting email- and domain-like tokens.

nodes.name: resolveBotMention
nodes.summary: Resolves either a textual bot mention or a <@bot-user-uuid> mention to a conversational bot kind for the org.

nodes.name: ensure-bots.ts
nodes.summary: Idempotently provisions the built-in AI bots (assistant, notetaker, answerer, standup) for an org as synthetic isBot User rows plus ChatBot config rows in a single transaction; bot users are deliberately not org members so they hold no permissions of their own.

nodes.name: ensureOrgBots
nodes.summary: Upserts the four built-in bot users and ChatBot rows for an org in one transaction and returns them keyed by bot key.

nodes.name: ingest.ts
nodes.summary: Document ingestion pipeline: stores the uploaded file via the storage adapter, creates a CUI-aware Document row, parses the buffer into normalized DocumentBlock rows with unique anchors and heading hierarchy, walking status PARSING to READY or FAILED without throwing on parse errors.
nodes.languageNotes: Parse failures are recorded on the Document row rather than thrown, so failed documents still list in the UI.

nodes.name: ingestDocument
nodes.summary: Validates format and 25 MB size limit, stores the original file, creates the Document row, parses it into anchored DocumentBlocks, links parent headings via a level stack, and finalizes status to READY or FAILED.

nodes.name: docx.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying the DOCX parser converts a sample document buffer into the expected heading and paragraph blocks.

nodes.name: pdf.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying the PDF parser extracts page text into paragraph blocks from a sample PDF buffer.

nodes.name: pptx.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying the PPTX parser extracts slide text runs into heading and paragraph blocks.

nodes.name: slug.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying anchorAssigner produces slugified anchors and de-duplicates collisions with numeric suffixes.

nodes.name: xlsx.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying the XLSX parser turns workbook sheets into heading plus table blocks.

nodes.name: docx.ts
nodes.summary: DOCX DocumentParser implementation: converts .docx buffers to HTML with mammoth, then delegates to htmlToBlocks for normalized block extraction.

nodes.name: html-to-blocks.ts
nodes.summary: Converts an HTML string into normalized ParsedBlocks — headings (h1-h6 with level), paragraphs, lists, quotes, and tables flattened to pipe-delimited rows.

nodes.name: htmlToBlocks
nodes.summary: Walks the parsed HTML tree mapping tag names to block kinds: h1-h6 become HEADING with a level, tables are flattened cell-by-cell into pipe-delimited TABLE blocks, everything else falls through to PARAGRAPH.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Parser registry and entry point: aggregates the docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx parsers, exposes SUPPORTED_FORMATS, parserFor(format) lookup, and formatFromName(filename) extension detection.

nodes.name: parserFor
nodes.summary: Returns the registered DocumentParser whose supported formats include the requested format, or undefined.

nodes.name: formatFromName
nodes.summary: Derives the file format from a filename extension and returns it only if it appears in SUPPORTED_FORMATS.

nodes.name: pdf.ts
nodes.summary: PDF DocumentParser implementation: extracts per-page text via unpdf (getDocumentProxy/extractText) and splits it on blank lines into paragraph blocks tagged with page numbers.

nodes.name: pptx.ts
nodes.summary: PPTX DocumentParser implementation: unzips slide XML with fflate, extracts and entity-decodes <a:t> text runs per paragraph, treating each slide's first paragraph as a heading.
nodes.languageNotes: Parses slide XML with regex over raw strings instead of an XML parser, keeping the dependency footprint to just fflate.

nodes.name: slug.ts
nodes.summary: Provides anchorAssigner, a closure that turns block text into slugified anchors and guarantees per-document uniqueness by appending numeric suffixes on collision.

nodes.name: anchorAssigner
nodes.summary: Returns an assign(text) closure that slugifies text to a max-70-char anchor and tracks used anchors in a Set, suffixing duplicates with -2, -3, and so on.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared parser contract types: BlockKind union, ParsedBlock shape (kind, level, text, html, data, page), ParseResult, and the DocumentParser interface every format parser implements.

nodes.name: xlsx.ts
nodes.summary: XLSX DocumentParser implementation using SheetJS: each workbook sheet becomes a heading block followed by a pipe-delimited TABLE block of its rows.

nodes.name: entity-fields.ts
nodes.summary: Client-safe registry (ENTITY_DEFS) for the generic PM importer: for each importable entity (deliverable, risk, milestone, CLIN, objective, goal, interval, blocker, change request, contract) it declares mappable fields, natural keys for idempotency, and a header auto-guesser. Work items are deliberately excluded and keep their own flow.
nodes.languageNotes: Shared by the client wizard and the server engine; keeps zero server-only imports so it can bundle into the browser.

nodes.name: getEntityDef
nodes.summary: Looks up an EntityDef in ENTITY_DEFS by its stable key.

nodes.name: guessFieldForHeader
nodes.summary: Auto-maps a source column header to an entity field by case-insensitive match against field keys, labels, and synonyms.

nodes.name: entity-import.ts
nodes.summary: Server engine for the generic entity importer: coerces mapped cells per field kind (date, number, int, bool, enum), dedupes rows by natural key against existing Prisma rows, then creates or updates the matching entity (10 PM entity types) producing a per-run report of creates, updates, warnings, and errors.
nodes.languageNotes: Idempotency is anchored on each entity's natural key — re-running the same import updates rows instead of duplicating them; contract imports lazily find-or-create Partner rows via a per-run cache.

nodes.name: coerceField
nodes.summary: Tolerantly coerces a raw cell string into the field's declared kind (text, date, number, int, bool, enum), returning a value or a human-readable warning.

nodes.name: mapRows
nodes.summary: Applies the column mapping to every request row, coercing each mapped cell and flagging rows that are missing required fields.

nodes.name: loadExistingIds
nodes.summary: Loads existing rows for the target entity within the org/project and indexes their ids by natural-key token so incoming rows can be matched for update instead of create.

nodes.name: createEntityRow
nodes.summary: Creates one Prisma row for the target entity from coerced fields, with per-entity shape logic — including derived risk score/level, interval sort order, and find-or-create of contract partners.

nodes.name: updateEntityRow
nodes.summary: Builds a sparse patch from the mapped fields and updates the existing entity row, recomputing risk score/level when likelihood or impact change and resolving contract partners.

nodes.name: runEntityImport
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a generic entity import: maps and validates rows, dedupes within the batch and against existing rows by natural key, then either returns a dry-run report or commits creates/updates and reports the outcome.

nodes.name: parse-file.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side CSV/TSV/XLSX parsing for the import wizards: parses files in the browser so mapping UI can preview headers and sample rows, with automatic header-row detection for the legacy single-shape path and full multi-sheet workbook matrices for the generic wizard. SheetJS is dynamically imported to stay out of the initial bundle.
nodes.languageNotes: Marked "use client"; the server only ever receives normalized rows plus the mapping, never the raw file.

nodes.name: parseDelimited
nodes.summary: Hand-rolled CSV/TSV parser handling quoted cells, escaped quotes, and embedded newlines, returning a raw string matrix.

nodes.name: guessHeaderRow
nodes.summary: Scores candidate rows to auto-detect which row of a matrix is the header, so title or description rows above real headers get skipped.

nodes.name: matrixToObjects
nodes.summary: Converts a raw string matrix plus a chosen header row into deduplicated headers and header-to-cell row objects.

nodes.name: parseWorkbook
nodes.summary: Parses an uploaded file into raw per-sheet string matrices — delimited text directly, spreadsheets via dynamically imported SheetJS — for the wizard that lets users pick sheet and header row.

nodes.name: parseImportFile
nodes.summary: Legacy single-shape entry point: reads sheet 0 of the workbook, auto-detects the header row, and returns { headers, rows }.

nodes.name: work-item-fields.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the work-item import contract helpers — Jira duration parsing to seconds and header/priority guessing.

nodes.name: items.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ingestItems with a mocked Prisma client, covering creation of the supported item kinds, validation failures, and error reporting per item.

nodes.name: items.ts
nodes.summary: BYO-LLM structured item-ingest contract: an external LLM converts a document into a flat items[] array (ISSUE / MILESTONE / OBJECTIVE / GOAL / INTERVAL / ROADMAP_NODE) validated by zod schemas; ingestItems creates each row via per-kind creators reusing in-app converter defaults, delegates roadmap nodes to upsertRoadmapNodes, and stores embeddings for issues.
nodes.languageNotes: The contract is deliberately LLM-friendly — only type plus title are required; ids, anchors, and defaults are derived server-side.

nodes.name: createIssue
nodes.summary: Creates a WorkItem from an ingested ISSUE item — resolving type and board column via resolveTypeAndColumn, applying priority/dates/tags, and storing a text embedding for RAG search.

nodes.name: createMilestone
nodes.summary: Creates a Milestone row from an ingested MILESTONE item with due date and status defaults.

nodes.name: createObjective
nodes.summary: Creates an Objective row from an ingested OBJECTIVE item, defaulting status and mapping optional interval linkage.

nodes.name: createGoal
nodes.summary: Creates a Goal (key result) row under its parent objective from an ingested GOAL item, including progress mode and target values.

nodes.name: createInterval
nodes.summary: Creates an Interval (sprint/PI) row from an ingested INTERVAL item with kind, dates, and computed sort order.

nodes.name: ingestItems
nodes.summary: Validates the posted items[] payload, dispatches each item to its per-kind creator (delegating ROADMAP_NODE batches to upsertRoadmapNodes), attributes creations to the authenticated user, and returns a per-item success/error report.

nodes.name: risk.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the risk scoring helpers — score multiplication and severity banding boundaries.

nodes.name: risk.ts
nodes.summary: Govcon risk scoring shared by the seed, write paths, and the PM Dashboard: score = likelihood x impact (1-25) banded into LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL severity levels for the Risk Register.

nodes.name: computeRiskScore
nodes.summary: Computes risk score as likelihood times impact, each on a 1-5 scale.

nodes.name: riskLevelFromScore
nodes.summary: Maps a 1-25 risk score onto its severity band: >=20 CRITICAL, >=12 HIGH, >=6 MEDIUM, else LOW.

nodes.name: import.ts
nodes.summary: Roadmap-node import engine shared by the seed scripts and the ingest API: normalizes incoming nodes (derived anchors, sortOrder, per-batch uniqueness with hard errors on duplicate externalRefs) and upserts the roadmap node tree for a project.

nodes.name: roadmapSlug
nodes.summary: Pure slugifier (no DB dependency) producing lowercase, hyphenated, max-70-char anchors safe for seed scripts and the API.

nodes.name: normalize
nodes.summary: Derives anchors and sortOrder for imported roadmap nodes, suffixing anchor collisions numerically and hard-erroring on duplicate non-null externalRefs that would violate the unique constraint.

nodes.name: nodeData
nodes.summary: Builds the Prisma create/update data shape for one normalized roadmap node.

nodes.name: upsertRoadmapNodes
nodes.summary: Upserts a batch of roadmap nodes for a project — matching existing rows by externalRef or anchor, creating the rest, wiring parent-child links, and returning an import report with warnings.

nodes.name: mentions.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the chat mention parser, covering @-mention token extraction, case normalization, and deduplication of mentioned user IDs.

nodes.name: mentions.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the chat mention regex (MENTION_RE) and parseMentions, which extracts the unique set of mentioned user IDs from message content.

nodes.name: messages.ts
nodes.summary: Core chat message creation service: persists a user message with validated mentions and attachments in a Prisma transaction, publishes it to the channel's realtime topic, syncs cross-entity references, and fans out notifications.

nodes.name: notifications.ts
nodes.summary: Fans a new chat message out to channel members: publishes unread updates to each member's realtime user topic, sends Microsoft Teams mention notices, and creates in-app notifications for mentioned users.

nodes.name: system-message.ts
nodes.summary: Posts server-authored (system) chat messages: creates the message, bumps channel last-activity, publishes to the channel's realtime topic, and triggers notification fan-out.

nodes.name: automation-config.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extensive unit tests for feedback automation configuration parsing, worker-count clamping, project pruning, and the enable-gate validation rules.

nodes.name: automation-config.ts
nodes.summary: Parses and validates org-level feedback automation settings (auto-remediation and autonomous delivery): reads raw JSON settings defensively, clamps delivery worker counts, prunes config to valid project IDs, and enforces the enable gate.

nodes.name: delivery-notify.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for delivery event notifications, building org/member/project/work-item fixtures via Prisma and asserting owner fan-out behavior.

nodes.name: delivery-notify.ts
nodes.summary: Notifies organization owners about autonomous delivery lifecycle events, consulting the org's automation config to decide which events warrant a notification before fanning out to all owner accounts.

nodes.name: google.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Google integration helpers, covering refresh-token storage and OAuth client construction paths.

nodes.name: google.ts
nodes.summary: Builds authenticated Google API clients (Calendar, Drive, Gmail, Docs, People, Meet) for a user by loading their stored OAuth refresh token from the credentials store and configuring a googleapis OAuth2 client.

nodes.name: create.ts
nodes.summary: Central in-app notification creator: persists a Notification row, publishes it to the recipient's realtime user topic, and triggers a best-effort web push delivery.

nodes.name: push.ts
nodes.summary: Web Push delivery layer using VAPID keys: sends a payload to all of a user's push subscriptions, skips delivery during the user's quiet hours, and disables or deletes dead subscriptions on failure.

nodes.name: parseMentions
nodes.summary: Extracts the deduplicated, lowercased set of user IDs mentioned in chat message content using MENTION_RE.

nodes.name: createUserMessage
nodes.summary: Creates a user chat message end-to-end: validates mentions against org membership, writes message, mention rows, channel activity and attachment links in one transaction, publishes the realtime event, syncs references, and fans out notifications.

nodes.name: fanOutChatMessage
nodes.summary: Fans a chat message out to channel members: publishes unread-count events per member, fires a Teams webhook for mentions, and creates in-app notifications for mentioned users.

nodes.name: postServerMessage
nodes.summary: Persists a system-authored chat message, updates channel last-activity, publishes it on the channel topic, and delegates member notification fan-out.

nodes.name: readAutoRemediation
nodes.summary: Safely parses the auto-remediation section of raw org settings into a typed config with defaults for missing or malformed fields.

nodes.name: readAutonomousDelivery
nodes.summary: Parses the autonomous-delivery section of raw settings, extracting enabled flag, project IDs, and a clamped worker count.

nodes.name: readAutomationConfig
nodes.summary: Top-level reader that converts an org's raw settings JSON into the combined feedback automation config (auto-remediation plus autonomous delivery).

nodes.name: pruneToProjects
nodes.summary: Filters an automation config's project ID lists down to a set of valid project IDs, disabling sections that lose all their projects.

nodes.name: validateEnableGate
nodes.summary: Enforces the rule that autonomous delivery may only be enabled when its prerequisites (such as auto-remediation coverage of the same projects) are satisfied.

nodes.name: fanOutToOwners
nodes.summary: Looks up all owner members of an org and creates the given notification for each, swallowing per-recipient failures.

nodes.name: notifyOrgOwners
nodes.summary: Public helper that sends an arbitrary notification to every organization owner via the owner fan-out.

nodes.name: notifyDeliveryEvent
nodes.summary: Notifies org owners about an autonomous delivery event, first checking the org's automation config to determine whether that event type should produce notifications.

nodes.name: storeGoogleRefreshToken
nodes.summary: Persists a user's Google OAuth refresh token into the credentials store, scoped to their primary organization.

nodes.name: getGoogleClientForUser
nodes.summary: Loads the user's stored Google refresh token, resolves the app's Google login credentials, and returns a configured googleapis OAuth2 client.

nodes.name: getCalendarClient
nodes.summary: Returns a Google Calendar API client authenticated as the given user.

nodes.name: getDriveClient
nodes.summary: Returns a Google Drive API client authenticated as the given user.

nodes.name: getGmailClient
nodes.summary: Returns a Gmail API client authenticated as the given user.

nodes.name: getDocsClient
nodes.summary: Returns a Google Docs API client authenticated as the given user.

nodes.name: getPeopleClient
nodes.summary: Returns a Google People (contacts) API client authenticated as the given user.

nodes.name: getMeetClient
nodes.summary: Returns a Google Meet API client authenticated as the given user.

nodes.name: createNotification
nodes.summary: Creates an in-app notification record, publishes it on the recipient's realtime user topic, and fires a best-effort web push to their devices.

nodes.name: initVapid
nodes.summary: Lazily configures the web-push library with VAPID keys from environment variables on first use.

nodes.name: pushToUser
nodes.summary: Sends a web push payload to every subscription of a user, skipping delivery during their quiet hours and marking failed subscriptions inactive or deleting expired ones.

nodes.name: getVapidPublicKey
nodes.summary: Exposes the VAPID public key for browser push subscription registration.

nodes.name: quiet-hours.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for quiet-hours evaluation, checking same-day and overnight windows at fixed instants across time zones.

nodes.name: quiet-hours.ts
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given instant falls within a user's configured quiet-hours window, converting to the user's time zone via Intl.DateTimeFormat and handling overnight (start > end) ranges.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Intl.DateTimeFormat formatToParts for timezone-local time extraction instead of a date library.

nodes.name: guard.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level rate limiting guard: derives a bucket key from the request and user, applies the token-bucket limiter, and returns a 429 NextResponse with Retry-After when the limit is exceeded.

nodes.name: adapter-memory.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the in-memory bus adapter covering publish/subscribe delivery, unsubscribe cleanup, and close semantics.

nodes.name: adapter-memory.ts
nodes.summary: In-process pub/sub bus adapter backed by a Map of topic to subscriber sets; used directly in single-instance deployments and as the local delivery layer for the Postgres adapter.

nodes.name: adapter-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY bus adapter for cross-instance realtime fan-out: wraps the memory bus for local delivery, broadcasts published events via NOTIFY, and reconnects with capped exponential backoff on connection errors.
nodes.languageNotes: Tags each message with a random sender UUID so instances can ignore their own NOTIFY broadcasts and avoid double delivery.

nodes.name: bus.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the realtime bus singleton, verifying adapter selection and the test-only reset hook.

nodes.name: bus.ts
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton accessor for the realtime event bus: picks the Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY adapter when a database URL is configured, falls back to the in-memory adapter otherwise, and exposes a reset hook for tests.

nodes.name: presence.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the presence registry covering connect/disconnect reference counting, heartbeats, and stale-entry sweeping.

nodes.name: presence.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory presence registry tracking which users are online per connection with heartbeat timestamps, exposing connect/disconnect/heartbeat operations and a sweep that drops stale entries.

nodes.name: topics.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for realtime topic name builders and parseTopic round-tripping.

nodes.name: topics.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical realtime topic naming: a topics builder object for org, channel, and user scoped topic strings, plus parseTopic to split a topic back into kind and id.

nodes.name: minutesInTimezone
nodes.summary: Returns the minutes-since-midnight for an instant in a given IANA time zone using Intl.DateTimeFormat parts.

nodes.name: isInQuietHours
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether the current time falls inside the user's quiet-hours preference window, correctly handling windows that cross midnight.
